determinism.scope: Independent real-scorer executions, complete records including reasons and provenance; baseline reporting fields reprojected using same helper as repeated run. Run timestamps reside only in metadata.

interrupted_attempt.reason: Replaced sequential repeat with bounded four-worker replay after focused tests passed.

scope: Real scorer on frozen stored enrichment; no regenerated enrichment, release, clinical approval, or app validation.

supplementary_dependency_inventory.scope: Observed during the first replay after provenance coverage was expanded. These are not pre-run hash observations. Each newly covered dependency is compared with the initial committed baseline. The independent repeat observes all these files before and after scoring.
